### L1 review (#35061) · 2026-11-18T09:04Z

L1: REWORK (one must-fix, a record only; the code is accepted)
Head-sha: d4174efd2c0c2e6980e07f66fb227645c8765137

This is the first L1 on this PR. I read the full diff against the merge base `958ee03594`: 20 files, +1423 / −126. I also read the card, claim 6970178241, premise correction 6970247348, os-dev reports 6972834799 and 6973474874, and final-head comment 6973891010.

**Item 4, the right slot's width** (`studioRightSlotState.ts`, `StudioRightSlot.tsx`). This matches the corrected premise.
- `clampStudioSlotWidth` keeps the slot within 320–560. It still keeps the canvas at or above `DOCK_CONTENT_MIN_WIDTH`, and the lower bound wins when the two meet.
- `useStudioSlotWidth(mode)` keeps one width per pane, under `-props` and `-copilot` keys, with defaults of 360 and 420. A drag or arrow key moves only the shown pane's width.
- The old shared key is removed on first read rather than migrated, and the changeset says so.
- The handle now carries `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax`.
- `chatDockState.ts` is read only, and `clampDockWidth` is untouched.

**Item 1, the left rails narrow** (`StudioRail.tsx`, `studio-tokens.ts`, `railAbbreviation.ts`, the host in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`).
- The rule is the `dataTabsFold.ts` route: a container query on the pillars host, `@max-[900px]/studio-pillars`. It is gated by the host's `data-studio-slot="open"`, which the surface sets only while the slot is shown beside the pillars and not under `md`. There is no JS width read and no edit-mode input, and `STUDIO_RAIL_WIDTH` stays on every rail. So objectui#12519, read as left rail only, holds, and the narrow form is the same in all four pillars.
- The threshold follows the seat's reading of 「中间内容区」 as the host, rail plus content. With the copilot at 420, a 1280 window narrows (860) and a 1440 window keeps the full rail (1020), which matches the card's two acceptance lines. The Chromium readings on the compiled CSS in the PR body give the same numbers.
- The narrow row's character is generated content with an empty alternative, and the label stays as `sr-only`, so the accessible name does not change. Rows and groups carry `data-studio-rail-item`, and anything else is hidden in the list.
- The 「»」 float closes on a picked row, on Escape (focus returns to 「»」) and on an outside pointer-down.
- Phones keep the rail's own overlay.

**Item 2, the permission matrix** (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `permissionMatrixFold.ts`).
- Both forms are in the DOM, and `@min-[1000px]` on the matrix pane displays exactly one of them.
- Flat stays Create / Read / Edit / Delete. The other four boxes and the two scope pickers move behind 「更多权限」 / "More permissions". Its count is ticked boxes plus scopes that are set, read from the drawn entry.
- The strip becomes one 「批量」 menu with the same four `onBulkSet` actions, disabled when the set is not writable.
- The folded controls are the same `ObjectRuleBox` and `ScopePicker`, so a read-only set locks them the same way.
- The 1304 px floor applies only to the flat form. Each `colSpan` gains the new column.
- Setup's table is not touched.

**Item 3, the Records grid** (`recordsGridChrome.ts`, `DataPillar`).
- The scrollbar is drawn at rest through a host-side descendant class.
- `revealColumn` scrolls the least that brings the selected column clear of the sticky columns before and after it. It never touches vertical scroll, and it runs only in grid view on a field selection.
- Column widths, the frozen name column and the 400 px ceiling are the runtime grid's, and are not edited. `plugin-grid/src` is untouched, so the claim's fork condition never arose.

**Shape and scope.**
- `Fixes #35061` is on the first card line, and all four items ship, so closing is right. No closing keyword sits next to another open card. There is no `content/docs/releases/` change.
- `check-governed-merges --pr 35128`: not governed, 1549 changed lines, under the 3,000-line threshold.
- `Clause-②: no` holds. The `studio` catalogues are typed `Record<string, string>` in the built declarations, which the report measured. The app-shell entry exports nothing from `views/studio-design/`, and of `PermissionMatrixEditor` it exports only `PermissionMatrixEditPage`, so the removed `STUDIO_SLOT_WIDTH_STORAGE_KEY`, the new `mode` argument and the new `name` prop are all module-internal. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right too.
- The changeset bumps `app-shell` and `i18n` at `patch` and is new, not on `main`. Its four bullets and the key list match the diff. All four keys are present in both `en` and `zh`, and the `studio` namespace has only those two packs.

**Tests and evidence.**
- New pins cover all four items: 6 fold cases, 8 Records cases with a real `DataPillar` mount, the rail's narrow describe, the slot's per-pane describe, and the surface's host-marker describe.
- Two existing pins changed, and each is explained: the 643 px slot pin moved to a 1000 px viewport, and the `draftObjectLabel` collector now skips the 「»」 control.
- The e2e red at `0be07d822` was caused by this PR. `d4174efd2` moves the Studio 720 px case to the folded form, keeps the Studio 1000 px case and both metadata-admin sweeps, and skips nothing. A one-time mutation of `PERM_MATRIX_TABLE_FLOOR` turns it red, and the restore is verified.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 39 derived and 39 run, all exit 0, at both heads.

**CI at this head**, from check-runs: 47 success, 15 skipped, none failed or in progress.

#### Must-fix
- **M1. Two changed paths are outside the claimed file surface, and no amendment declares them.**
  - The paths are `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/permissionMatrixFold.ts` (new) and `ui/e2e/permission-field-panel-scroll.spec.ts` (an existing e2e spec, edited).
  - Claim 6970178241 names, under `metadata-admin/`, only `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` and `i18n.ts`, plus new test files named for the card. It says "Stop on breach; explain in the report." Neither report lists these two paths under deviations.
  - The reasons are sound. The fold's class literals and threshold are item 2's, and the e2e case asserted the 1304 px floor that item 2 removes by design.
  - Fix: post a claim amendment on #35061 naming both paths with those reasons. No new head is needed. I'll read the amendment alone and ACCEPT on it at this head.

#### Should-fix
None.

#### Notes
- **N1.** `StudioRailRow` now sets `title={fullName}` on every row in both forms, unless the caller passes its own `title`. So the full-width rails gain a native hover that repeats the visible label. The changeset describes the hover for the narrow form only. This is harmless, and it helps a truncated label. A later card can limit it to the narrow form if the double hover is unwanted.
- **N2.** No ablation was run for items 1, 3 and 4, and for item 2 only the e2e floor was mutated. Each is a new behaviour pinned by new cases that cannot pass on `main`, so I accept it for a feature card.
- **N3. NOT MEASURED, accepted as declared.** The card's acceptance lines in a booted console at 1280×800 were not measured. Item 1 is read from the real rail markup and its compiled CSS in Chromium, and items 2 and 3 from jsdom pins and the e2e spec. `Fixes` closes the card at merge, so if the seat wants the four acceptance lines read live, that check is owed before landing.
- **Owed after L1, not mine.** No L2 by surface (ui only, `Clause-②: no`, not governed).

- It adds `ui/e2e/permission-field-panel-scroll.spec.ts`. The reason given is that the Studio 720 px case asserted the 1304 px floor that item 2 removes by design.
- Both reasons match what I read in the code. The remaining 18 paths are inside the claimed surface: `studio-design/**`, `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `i18n/namespaces/studio/**`, new test files named for the card, and `.changeset/`.

Everything in 6973950296 stands for this head. That covers the four items, the seat's readings, `Clause-②: no`, the changeset, the tests and CI (47 success, 15 skipped, none failed). N1–N3 stand as notes.

#### Must-fix
None.

#### Should-fix
None.

#### Notes
- **N3 (from 6973950296) belongs to the seat.** The live 1280×800 acceptance reading was not measured. If the seat wants it read, that has to happen before landing, because `Fixes` closes the card when the PR merges.
